svg.text: PREFILL-DECODE (PD) DISAGGREGATION VS. COLOCATED CHUNKED PREFILL BOUNDARY
400G RDMA PD Disaggregation Cuts P99 TPOT 3.57x (58.5ms -> 16.4ms) & Lifts Goodput 2.18x
16K Prompt / 512 Output (I:O = 32:1): Tier 1 Naive Colocated (148ms TPOT) vs. Tier 2 Chunked Prefill (58.5ms) vs. Tier 4 PD Split (16.4ms)
⚖️ Why Prefill & Decode Interfere (And When to Keep Colocated)
1. Roofline Regime Collision on Co-Located GPUs:
• Prefill is Compute-Bound (`AI > 300 FLOPs/B`, saturates TensorCores)
• Decode is Bandwidth-Bound (`AI ~ 1-16 FLOPs/B`, starves on HBM)
• Inserting 16K Prefill pauses running Decode streams for 60–148ms!
2. Chunked Prefill (Tier 2) Trade-Off:
• Splits 16K prompt into 1K chunks piggybacked with Decode; still
reloads KV 16x and spikes P99 TPOT to 58.5ms (>25ms SLA!)
✅ Keep Colocated + Chunked Prefill When:
• Pool `<= 8 GPUs`, Prompt `< 2K tokens`, `I:O < 4:1`, or no RDMA!
Colocated Performance on 16K Long-Prompt RAG / Agent:
• P99 Decode TPOT: 148.0ms (Tier 1) / 58.5ms (Tier 2 Chunked)
• SLA-Compliant Goodput: 520 tok/s/GPU (T1) / 890 tok/s/GPU (T2)
• Cost per 1M SLA Tokens: $0.92 (Tier 1) / $0.64 (Tier 2)
🏆 Tier 4: RDMA PD Disaggregation (Dynamo / Mooncake)
1. Independent Parallelism & Batching per Phase:
• Prefill Pool: High `TP=8` (compute-optimized, batch=1–4, zero KV wait)
• Decode Pool: Large batch (`B=64–256`) + `EP/DP` (maximizes HBM MBU)
2. Layer-Wise Zero-Copy GPUDirect RDMA KV Push (`<30ms`):
• Streams each layer's KV over 400G RoCEv2/IB (`45 GB/s` via NIXL /
Mooncake Transfer Engine) overlapped with Layer $L+1$ Prefill!
🚀 Mandate PD Disaggregation When:
• Fleet `>= 16 GPUs`, Prompt `>= 4K`, `I:O >= 8:1`, `P99 TPOT <= 25ms`,
and `100G–400G RDMA` (or MLA / GQA + FP8 KV) is available
Tier 4 Verified Production Benchmarks (16K In / 512 Out):
• P99 Decode TPOT: 16.4 ms (-3.57x vs. Chunked Colocated)
• SLA-Compliant Goodput: 1,940 tok/s/GPU (2.18x higher yield)
• Cost per 1M SLA Tokens: $0.34 / 1M (-46.9% vs. Tier 2)
